description: He wears an ivory ankle-length tunic with a small round neckline, long sleeves and gold-and-dark embroidered bands down the front, at the cuffs and around the hem. A deep plum outer robe and broad draped shoulder fabric have richly woven circular and geometric gold borders. Round gold clasps fasten the robe near both shoulders. A dark embroidered belt with a round clasp and hanging medallion ornament defines the waist. Dark trousers show beneath the hem, tucked into dark brown ankle-height leather boots with gold embroidered upper trim.
